title: Project State Schema
body:
This record covers Project State Schema within the Long-Horizon Project State Database. Preserves progress, pending work, decisions, and next actions. The record is written as a complete, human-readable file: it states what the method is, when it applies, what it needs, what it produces, and where its limits lie.

How it works. State-record method: progress, pending work, decisions, and next actions are stored as one durable record that survives across sessions.
